content.thinking: The shell build completed cleanly (2544 blocks, no refusals, no floating blocks), though `mcd check` flags 8 orphan sandstone blocks in the bay frames that should resolve once the front part adds panes and the roof part adds decks. I couldn't tick the plan/elements checklists (no checkboxes present, and the `sed` on elements.md failed on macOS), so I just noted the deliberately empty cells in plan.md.

input.summary: Masonry shell built: plinth, brick A/C and sandstone B walls, party walls with pilasters, quoins, string course, canted bay bodies and floors y2/7/12/17. Openings, wells, stack cells and bay decks are left as air. make.sh clean, no refusals; check shows no floating blocks.
left: Bay window frames show 8 orphan sandstone blocks until the front part glazes and the roofs part decks them
plan.md and elements.md checklist items were not ticked (plan.md has no checkboxes; the elements.md sed failed on macOS)

waste.what: Wrote the opening lists for all faces by hand as coordinate boxes and mirrored them for C
waste.tool: A shared openings table (from plan.md OPENINGS) exported from vocab, so the shell skips and the front part glazes from one source

waste.what: Wrote my own bay body, wall loop and quoin pattern because cantedBay places panes itself and wallCourse is one slab at a time
waste.tool: A box-wall helper taking an opening predicate, and a cantedBay option with panes: false

companions.task: Rear and side quoins, weathering variants on the brick, and plinth detail
Panes, sills and heads in the openings left in the walls
